The final identification of the phases was done using the XRD patterns.

items.quote: Due to the fact that Al can react with the quartz tube at elevated temperatures, and high vapor pressure of phosphorus, the powders of the three elements were mixed, pressed into discs and put into a corundum crucible which was sealed in an evacuated quartz tube.

items.label: Alloy 7
items.quote: Metallurgical examinations and EDS analyses of Alloy 7 revealed that α -Al, Zn3 P2 and ZnP2 coexisted in this alloy.

items.label: Alloy 3
items.quote: SEM-EDS analyses and XRD studies of Alloy 3 indicated that it consisted of the α -Al phase, the Zn3 P2 phase and the η-Zn phase.

items.label: Alloy 1
items.quote: Fig. 3 shows the microstructure and XRD pattern of Alloy 1; it confirms clearly the existence of the (η-Zn + Zn3 P2 ) two-phase equilibrium state.
